title: High-Resolution Resonant Layer Sweep with Fixed Non-Resonant Backbone
scientific_hypothesis: Fixing 9 non-resonant layers to iteration_27's best candidate values while applying fine-grained optimization (±0.5 nm resolution) exclusively to the three resonant layers (indices 2, 6, 11) will improve passband flatness without degrading UV/NIR suppression, as these layers dominate cavity resonance conditions.
design_principle: Selective optimization reduces search space dimensionality while preserving the verified suppression mechanism; resonant layers control passband center and width while non-resonant layers maintain stopband reflectivity.
proposed_topology: 12-layer alternating stack: Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2|Ta2O5|SiO2 on fused silica substrate, air incidence
theory_basis: Fabry-Perot resonance theory: cavity layers determine passband center wavelength
Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
expected_advantages: Fine resolution captures local optima missed by coarse search
known_risks: Over-constraining may prevent escape from local optimum
Fixed layer values may not be globally optimal
execution_request_english: Optimize a 12-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 alternating stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 deg unpolarized illumination. Fix layers 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12 to thicknesses [24.31, 30.06, 25.13, 45.15, 20.44, 37.41, 48.05, 27.53, 21.30] nm respectively. Optimize only layers 2, 6, 11 with initial values [140.88, 139.40, 161.02] nm and bounds [20, 350] nm. Spectral targets: minimize average transmittance at 355 nm (single wavelength), minimize average transmittance in 355-365 nm band, minimize average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm band, maximize average transmittance in 420-700 nm band. Add passband ripple penalty term weighted at 0.1 to encourage flat response. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with 0.5 nm resolution steps. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of insight appendage directive: fix 9 non-resonant layers to iteration_27 round_6 values, apply high-resolution sweep to layers 2, 6, 11, add passband ripple penalty
